bull_bear.body: Prioritizing AI talent hiring, Databricks partnership expansion, potential inorganic acquisition (Databricks-aligned PS firms), Healtheon ecosystem leverage; no dividends or buybacks mentioned
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Tech client consolidation risk (one client accounted for $7M loss); AI services arms of OpenAI/Anthropic entering enterprise space; margin compression if USD/INR reverses; execution risk in scaling forward-deployed engineer model
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Optimistic and confident; emphasized AI as core growth engine, validated by 49% revenue impact; highlighted Databricks and Healtheon as strategic differentiators; acknowledged tech headwinds but stressed recovery momentum and pipeline strength
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: AI revenue includes no token pass-through — all revenue retained; Healtheon’s agentic framework is being used as a reusable component for other healthcare clients; Databricks partnership is being leveraged to target acquisition targets with pre-existing Databricks credentials
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: BFSI: $18M revenue (FY26, +80% YoY); CPG/retail: accelerated by Decision Point acquisition (16% of revenue, +18-22% FY27 guidance); Tech: 55% of revenue (down from 70% in FY25), -7M shrinkage from one client but +5-8% FY27 growth expected; Rest of World: 15% revenue (up from 6% 8Qs ago)
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- The company frames its history as "Twenty years of compounding, three deliberate shifts": 2007–2014 FOUNDATION ("Foundational projects and a strategic partnership with Microsoft; growth-focused CEO appointed"), 2015–2020 SPECIALIZATION ("industry-specific verticals"), and 2021–Present "SCALE & AI" ("Data & AI capabilities scaled through acquisitions; transitioned to a public company").
- Stated FY26 milestone: "Revenue crossed ₹1,000 Cr+".
- AI is presented as the current mix driver, with "35% AI Led Revenue Q1FY27" called out alongside "7 New logos added" and "4.2% Existing clients growth on LTM basis".
- Third-party positioning cited: ISG Provider Lens Retail-CPG & Supply Chain Analytics "2025 Leader"; AIM PeMa Quadrant Data Engineering & Agentic AI Service Providers "2025 Leader"; Forrester Wave Marketing Measurement & Optimization "Strong Performer - Q1 2026 Wave"; Minsky Award @ Cypher 2025 for "Most Innovative Use of AI in Service Delivery"; RTIH 2026 Winner (AI & Payments).
- Client franchise is long-tenured: "69% From 5+ year clients", "26% From 1-5 years clients", "5% From less than 1 year clients".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [New logo wins] Three key clients added this quarter, all described without names: pricing and supply-chain analytics plus data foundational support for "a leading US-based recycled OEM automotive parts provider" (Technology); marketing analytics, dashboard modernization and AI-driven customer analytics for "one of the top asset management firms" (Financial Services); and "Cloud data migration, platform engineering, and data foundational work for a global fintech platform" (Financial Services).
- [Board changes] Two independent-director terms ended during/around the quarter — "Term ended 17/06/26" and "Term ended 22/07/26". The board page lists Anindya Ghose, Dipali Sheth, Mukesh Butani, Raghuama Rao, Reed Cundi and Sudha Sankaran as independent directors, but the extraction lost which two names the term-end dates attach to, so no name is asserted here.
- [Leadership] Sonal Ramrakhiani is listed as Chief Executive Officer, Rajan Bala Venkatesan as CFO, Remadevi Thoathil as CHRO, and Rajan Sethuraman as "Strategic Advisor to CEO"; Venkat Viswanathan is Chairperson and Pramadwathi Jandhyala an Executive Director.
- [Inorganic history] The 2021–Present phase states "Data & AI capabilities scaled through acquisitions", but the deck names no acquired entity, price or date.
- [People certification] "Great Place to Work Certified 2025-26 | 4th Consecutive Year" — the only workforce/ESG-adjacent credential in the deck.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: 24.1% Q4 EBITDA supported by forex (+1.1%), labor cost normalization (-1.5% one-off), offset by travel/visa (+1.1%); future margin levers: offshore/nearshore shift for tech clients, sustained USD/INR tailwinds, utilization normalization post-project ramp
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: 18-20% organic (FY27); margin: sustain 23-24% EBITDA via offshore/nearshore shift & forex tailwinds; order inflow: 18-22% CPG, 40% BFSI, 5-8% tech growth; capex/commissioning: minimal (no major capex planned, focus on talent & partnerships)
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: 12-13% visibility at FY27 start; pipeline includes 3 large tech deals ($3M, $1.5M, $1M), new financial services client ($5M+), Databricks co-sell opportunities, Healtheon agent integration
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: AI agent platformization via Healtheon (healthcare revenue cycle); Databricks professional services acquisition target; forward-deployed engineer model scaling; global expansion beyond U.S. (Europe traction growing)
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: AI adoption now drives 49% of revenue (28% visible, 21% under-the-hood), offsetting a $7M tech client shrinkage; BFSI and CPG retail grew 80% and 18-22% YoY respectively, with Databricks and Healtheon partnerships creating new growth vectors beyond traditional IT services.

meta.thesis: AI adoption now drives 49% of revenue (28% visible, 21% under-the-hood), offsetting a $7M tech client shrinkage; BFSI and CPG retail grew 80% and 18-22% YoY respectively, with Databricks and Healtheon partnerships creating new growth vectors beyond traditional IT services.
